purpose: Teach: レフ/栄養素/ボーイング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、レフ、つまりレフ板を駆使した広告撮影をされた
lines.en: Your father, in his younger days, shot advertising photos with masterful use of the ref — the reflector board, that is.
lines.style: Slow contemplative opening, gentle reminiscing warmth, a deliberate pause before restating the term.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の栄養素管理に厳しかった
lines.en: Yes. My father was strict about managing his employees' nutrient intake.
lines.style: Firm low affirmation on the yes, then measured, respectful evenness remembering his father.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、ボーイング機で初めて海外出張された
lines.en: Your father took his first overseas business trip on a Boeing, back when he was young.
lines.style: Wistful lift on the memory, slow pace, quiet admiration warming the final phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんはボーイング社視察に行かれた
lines.en: Yes. He even went on an inspection visit to the Boeing company itself.
lines.style: Controlled surface with quiet pride underneath, even pace, slight softening at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、社員の栄養素バランスを大事にされた
lines.en: Even as a young man, your father cared deeply about his employees' nutritional balance.
lines.style: Settling, lesson-closing cadence, unhurried, warm final emphasis with a faint audible smile.
